verdict.rationale: The pricing page says OpenHands Open Source and Cloud plans support bringing your own LLM keys and describes the product as "Model agnostic". The GitHub README says "Use with any LLM", and the SDK's OpenHandsAgentSettings lets you define the agent's model explicitly. Missing for 10: detailed provider and key configuration docs (supported providers, setup steps, whether Enterprise also allows BYO keys), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
